leads.title: Modinos v. Cyprus - European Court of Human Rights (1993)
leads.documents: Foundational decriminalization ruling; Court ruled section 171 of Cyprus Criminal Code violated right to private life under European Convention on Human Rights.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Modinos v. Cyprus, at the European Court of Human Rights' by Alexandros Modinos, architect/gay rights activist; Convention ratified by Cyprus in 1962; Articles 171-174 of Chapter 154 of Cypriot Criminal Code. No URL visible in article text.

leads.title: Equal Treatment in Employment and Occupation Law 2004
leads.documents: Cyprus anti-discrimination employment law explicitly forbidding discrimination on basis of sexual orientation; basis for workplace protections.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Equal Treatment in Employment and Occupation Law 2004 (Greek: Ο Περί Ίσης Μεταχείρισης στην Απασχόληση και την Εργασία Νόμος του 2004)'; designed to comply with EU Employment Framework Directive of 2000. No URL visible.

leads.title: Cypriot Penal Code Article 99 - Incitement to violence or hatred due to sexual orientation or gender identity
leads.documents: Hate-speech/hate-crime provision covering sexual orientation and gender identity; penalty up to 3 years and fine; raised to €10,000 in Oct 2024.
leads.detail: Quoted as Article 99 'intentionally, publicly... urges or incites... violence or hatred'; October 2024 Parliament raised penalty from €5,000 to €10,000. No URL visible.

leads.title: Cyprus Civil Union Law 2015 - House of Representatives vote
leads.documents: Legal recognition for same-sex couples via civil unions; documents relationship-recognition status vs marriage limited to man-woman.
leads.detail: Passed 26 November 2015 with 39 in favour, 12 against, 3 abstentions; published 9 December 2015 and took effect same day. No URL visible.

leads.title: Cyprus Parliament vote criminalizing conversion therapy - 25 May 2023
leads.documents: Ban on conversion therapy, key protection for LGBT/trans persons.
leads.detail: Cited as 'On 25 May 2023, the Cyprus Parliament voted to criminalize conversion therapy.' No URL visible.

leads.title: Northern Cyprus Criminal Law amendment - 27 January 2014
leads.documents: Repeal of colonial-era law punishing homosexual acts with up to 5 years; completed decriminalization across Cyprus/Europe.
leads.detail: Passed by Turkish Cypriot deputies 27 Jan 2014; noted as last territory in Europe to decriminalise; includes ILGA statement by Paulo Corte-Real. No URL visible.

leads.title: United States Department of State Human Rights Report on Cyprus (2017)
leads.documents: Institutional assessment of enforcement: incitement law (up to 5 years/€10,000), 11 complaints in 2015, fragmented equality legislation, societal discrimination, employment bias against LGBTI.
leads.detail: Section quoted: 'Freedom of Expression, Including for the Press' and 'Acts of Violence, Discrimination, and Other Abuses Based on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity' and 'Discrimination with Respect to Employment'. No URL visible.

leads.title: UN Universal Periodic Review of Cyprus (2019)
leads.documents: Rights machinery review; Cyprus received seven LGBT recommendations (combat discrimination/violence, criminalise harassment, action plan vs homophobia/transphobia, gender recognition law) and accepted all seven.
leads.detail: Cited as 'As part of its Universal Periodic Review in 2019, Cyprus received seven recommendations pertaining to LGBT rights... It accepted all seven'. No URL visible.

leads.title: ILGA-Europe - Rainbow Europe: Cyprus (20 February 2024)
leads.documents: Annual institutional benchmarking of LGBT rights/legal status in Cyprus.
leads.detail: Listed under Sources and external links as '"Rainbow Europe: Cyprus". ILGA-Europe. 20 February 2024.' No URL visible in excerpt.

leads.title: Ministry of Education programme HOMBAT - Combating Homophobic and Transphobic Bullying at Schools (2017)
leads.documents: Government anti-bullying machinery training teachers on LGBT-directed harassment; shows state response capacity.
leads.detail: Cited as established in 2017 by Ministry of Education to 'train and sensibilise teachers and professors'. No URL visible.
